name: Kaiser Permanente Santa Clara Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
city: Santa Clara, CA (Homestead campus, 710 Lawrence Expressway)
what_you_do: You give a warm welcome to members and guests, greet people, and walk visitors through the medical center. No medical background is needed.
who_can_apply: Volunteers 16 years and older. The page lists separate steps for 16 and 17 year olds. You must give at least one 4-hour shift each week, Monday to Friday between 8 am and 6 pm, for a planned one year commitment.
duration: One 4-hour weekday shift a week for a planned one year
deadline_text: No deadline posted. On 2026-10-16 the Santa Clara High School Programs listing showed an Apply button.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Kaiser volunteer site. Look under High School Programs at Santa Clara Homestead. Then do a video interview. Next is a health check where you bring your shot records. A parent must come with you. Last are online trainings and an in person orientation. Volunteer office: 408-851-1717.
notes: Read on Kaiser's volunteer site on 2026-10-16. The kp.org Santa Clara page links to it at kpvolunteer.samaritan.com. Shifts are on weekdays only, 8 am to 6 pm. Most students would need a free period, a late afternoon or summer days. A background check with a Social Security number is only for people over 18. The page asks for shot records. It does not say which shots, if you need a TB test, or if there are fees. Kaiser does not offer job shadowing.
